archetype: Neo-Brutalism (Custom mix of Archetype 4 Swiss High-Contrast & Archetype 6 Vibrant Play)
design_philosophy: Indie game UI + meme page + productivity tool. Controlled chaos. No boring corporate vibes. High contrast, sticker-style UI, hard black borders, and punchy flat colors. Everything is pressable and tangible.

patterns: Slightly rotate cards by 1 or -1 degrees to make them look like stickers.
Overlap elements using absolute positioning and high z-index with heavy borders.
Never center everything perfectly. Use negative space and jagged alignments to create tension.

components.button: font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 border-[3px] border-black bg-[#FFE600] text-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-transform active:shadow-none active:translate-x-[4px] active:translate-y-[4px]
components.card: border-[4px] border-black bg-white shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] p-6 flex flex-col
components.input: border-[3px] border-black px-4 py-3 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#00E5FF] focus:border-black font-medium
components.badge: border-[2px] border-black px-3 py-1 bg-[#FF4D6D] text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]
components.brutal_popup: fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-[#FF4D6D]/90 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-6 border-[12px] border-black

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Adhere strictly to the Neo-Brutalism theme. Use hard black shadows (e.g. shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]), bold borders, and vibrant colors (Yellow, Cyan, Pink, Green).
NO gradients, NO soft blurs. All shadows must be solid black.
Use Javascript (.js) and JSX (.jsx) for React components, DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
All interactive elements and essential information MUST have 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., data-testid='drink-water-btn').
When customizing Shadcn components, strip out their default rounded corners, borders, and subtle shadows. Replace them with heavy border-[3px] border-black and hard black shadows.
Embrace the 'sticker' vibe by using framer-motion to slightly tilt (-1deg to 2deg) cards on load or hover, and create a heavy press effect on clicks (removing shadow and translating down/right).
Microcopy is not corporate. Use the fun, aggressive, playful tones provided in the microcopy section.
